_comment: Serbian month names are the INTERNATIONAL Latin-derived set, unlike Croatian (siječanj) and Czech (leden), which kept the Slavic names — this is one of the sharpest points where Serbian and Croatian diverge. monthsInDate is therefore identical to months: Serbian writes the nominative inside a date (15. август 2026.), where Czech switches to the genitive. Note the trailing full stop in both formats: a Serbian numeric date closes with a dot after the year, because each element is an ordinal.
